summary: HDFC Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K with the SEC for July 2026, announcing that it filed its annual Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026. The filing does not disclose any special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The press release merely provides information on how shareholders can access the audited financial statements and contact the company secretary. This is a routine annual reporting obligation for a foreign private issuer.
